laws.rule: Visitors on a tour must keep to public order and manners, respect local customs, culture and religion, look after tourism resources and the environment, follow the civil-tourism code, and follow safety warnings and emergency measures. They may not harm local residents' lawful interests or disturb other visitors (article 34). Where another law already sets a penalty for a visitor's breach, that law applies (article 68).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
laws.heading: 安徽省旅游条例 (Anhui Province Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: Huangshan: these acts are banned in the scenic area: clearing or farming land, grazing, felling bamboo or trees, hunting, picking plants, flowers, fruit or fungi, carving or scribbling on features, picnic cooking, setting off fireworks, burning incense or paper outside religious sites, and dumping rubbish (article 12). Outdoor fire needs the management committee's approval, and carrying fire into the area is banned in high forest-fire periods (article 16). Pine plants and products may not be brought in (article 17). Visitors must keep to viewing order and safety rules, may not enter undeveloped areas, and may not go exploring or rock climbing there (article 25).
laws.penalty_signal: Outdoor fire without approval, or in high fire danger: warning and, for an individual, CNY 1,000 to 3,000 (about A$213 to A$640) (article 28). Ignoring visiting order, entering undeveloped areas, exploring or climbing there after being told to stop: warning or CNY 1,000 to 3,000 (about A$213 to A$640) (article 31). Carrying pine plants in: up to CNY 1,000 to 3,000 (about A$213 to A$640) (article 29). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 黄山风景名胜区管理条例 (Huangshan Scenic Area Administration Regulation)

laws.rule: Jiuhua Mountain: banned acts include digging, quarrying, picnic cooking and other unsafe use of fire, scribbling or carving on features and facilities, grazing in the second-level protected zone and above, and dumping rubbish (article 8). Outdoor fire needs approval in fire-prevention periods and is banned in high-danger periods. Visitors may not enter areas not yet opened or go exploring or rock climbing there in ways that endanger the site or themselves (article 24).
laws.penalty_signal: Disturbing visiting order, entering unopened areas, exploring or climbing there after being told to stop: warning or CNY 1,000 to 3,000 (about A$213 to A$640) (article 30). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 九华山风景名胜区管理条例 (Jiuhua Mountain Scenic Area Administration Regulation)

laws.rule: Tianzhu Mountain (Anqing): banned acts in the scenic area are damaging garden buildings, signs and seats, breaking branches or picking plants and wild fruit, scribbling or carving on features, littering, smoking or burning incense and candles outside designated areas, dumping building waste and hunting (article 21). Entering areas not opened to visitors, and exploring, rock climbing or swimming that endangers the site or oneself, is banned (article 32). Pine plants and products may not be brought in (article 19).
laws.penalty_signal: Damaging facilities: CNY 100 to 500 (about A$21.33 to A$107) (CNY 500 to 2,000 (about A$107 to A$427) in serious cases). Picking plants: CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66). Littering: CNY 50 (about A$10.67). Smoking or burning incense outside designated areas: CNY 50 to 500 (about A$10.67 to A$107) (article 38). Entering unopened areas or exploring after being told to stop: warning or CNY 1,000 to 3,000 (about A$213 to A$640), and rescue costs are paid by the organiser or the person rescued (article 41). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
